commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Villarreal is cautioned for aggressive play.
90+2' The opposition give Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
90+1' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
89' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Georges Mikautadze will be replaced by Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal).
89' Substitution. Pape Gueye did his best and is replaced by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
89' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Santi Comesana is replaced by Thomas Partey (Villarreal).

87' That's unlucky! Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
86' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
85' Pellegrino Matarazzo isn't happy on the touchline after referee Miguel Ortiz shows him a yellow card.

84' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
84' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) coming on for Mikel Oyarzabal.
82' Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad).
81' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
80' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) blew a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross deep inside the box, but his shot flew just over the bar.
78' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
77' Villarreal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
76' A pass into the box finds Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alex Remiro denies him.
75' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
74' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal) replacing Alberto Moleiro.
74' A substitution has been made. Gerard Moreno is replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).

73' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the left post.
72' It looks like Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) saw red with that tackle. Miguel Ortiz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
71' The attendance for today's match is 18032.
69' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
68' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Jon Aramburu and he is replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
68' That's the end of the game for Brais Mendez, who is replaced by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad).
67' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
67' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
63' Dangerous play by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad). Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) handles the ball inside the box.
59' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
56' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) takes the pass from Ander Barrenetxea in his stride and from mid-range fires in a thunderous shot, but it lacks direction and goes well wide of the left post.
55' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alex Remiro is quickest to intercept the ball.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Igor Zubeldia departs the field of play to be replaced by Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad).
52' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

52' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Alex Remiro has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
50' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
50' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.

50' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.

47' 3 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a strong shot into the top of the net. His attempt was beyond the reach of Luiz Junior, so the score changes to 3:1.
46' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

46' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' Half-time substitution. Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) is replaced by Luka Sucic.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+6' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) latches on to the ball from the corner kick and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. He can't direct his shot goalwards as it goes well wide of the left post.
45+6' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45+6' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Villarreal get a corner.
45+3' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Alex Remiro is alert and denies him with a nice save.
45+3' The players claim that Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right.
45+2' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same.
44' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
43' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the crossbar.
42' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
39' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
39' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
38' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
36' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
32' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.
32' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends a chip pass into the box, but Luiz Junior is quickest to intercept the ball. Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.
30' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Luiz Junior, who smothers the ball.
28' Chance! Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Luiz Junior is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
28' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
23' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Georges Mikautadze provided an assist for the goal.
21' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!

21' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Remiro pulls off a brilliant save.
21' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
19' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
15' 2 - 0 Goal! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Gerard Moreno, then sends the ball into the middle of the net. 2:0.
13' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
13' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
7' 1 - 0 Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
7' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Villarreal.
5' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
3' Some great controlled play and passing from Real Sociedad. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
